name: Identity Persistence Under Mutation Law
purpose: Define operational identity persistence across continuation-channel mutation and topology change.

candidate_law_statement.informal: Identity persists when a continuation channel mutates while retaining enough admissibility-compatible reinforcement continuity and accessibility coherence to remain operationally traceable as the same process-family.

formal.identity_relation_candidate: Id_A(C_P,C_P') holds iff Continuity_A(C_P,C_P'), Drift(C_P,C_P') < η_Id, and ReinforcementOverlap(H(C_P),H(C_P')) ≥ θ_Id
formal.fork_condition: Fork(C_P → {C_i}) occurs when multiple descendants preserve partial identity continuity above threshold.
formal.merge_condition: Merge({C_i} → C_M) preserves composite identity only under declared ancestry/equivalence conditions.
formal.identity_collapse_condition: Identity collapse occurs when drift, reconstruction loss, or reinforcement discontinuity exceeds declared identity tolerance.
formal.nonprimitive_identity_clause: Identity is an operational persistence relation, not a primitive object substance.
